sections.shortTitle: Punjab Seized and Freezed Facilities Hospitals and Dispensaries Act 2019
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT XXII OF 2019
ACT XXII OF 2019
PUNJAB SEIZED AND FREEZED FACILITIES
(HOSPITALS AND DISPENSARIES) ACT, 2019
An Act to establish the Hospitals and Dispensaries
Management Board in the Punjab
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
13th December, 2019]
Punjab
Seized and Freezed Facilities (Hospitals and Dispensaries) Act, 2019 was passed
by the Punjab Assembly on 20 November 2019; assented to by the Governor of the
Punjab on 10 December 2019; and was published in the Punjab Gazette (Extraordinary),
dated 13 December 2019, pages 2531-35.
It
is necessary to establish the Hospitals and Dispensaries Management Board; to
manage the seized and freezed Facilities; to ensure mainstreaming of employees
of such Facilities; and to provide for the matters connected therewith and
ancillary thereto.
Be
it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title, extent and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be cited as the Punjab Seized and Freezed Facilities (Hospitals
and Dispensaries) Act, 2019.
(2) It
extends to whole of the Punjab and shall apply to such Facilities as may be
notified by the Government.
(3) It
shall come into force from such date as the Government may, by notification in
the official Gazette, specify.

It

ancillary thereto.
Be
it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
2. Definitions.---In this Act:
(a) "Act"
means the Punjab Seized and Freezed Facilities (Hospitals and Dispensaries)
Act, 2019;
(b) "Board"
means the Board constituted under section 3 of the Act;
(c) "Chairperson"
means the Chairperson of the Board;
(d) "Committee"
means a Committee constituted by the Board under the Act;
(e) "Directorate"
means the Directorate established under section 7 of the Act;
(f) "Government"
means Government of the Punjab;
(g) "Facilities"
means the hospitals, dispensaries, and ambulances freezed and seized under
section 2 of the United Nations (Security Council) Act, 1948 (XIV of 1948) read
with the United Nations Security Council (Freezing and Seizure) Order, 2019,
published in the Gazette of Pakistan on 4th March 2019, and any other Facility
notified by the Government under the Act and includes an establishment, a
property or an organization attached thereto;
(h) "member"
means a member of the Board;
(i) "prescribed"
means prescribed by the rules made or the regulations framed under the Act;
(j) "regulations"
means the regulations framed by the Board under the Act;
(k) "rules"
means the rules made by the Board under the Act; and
(l) "seizing
agency" means a seizing agency notified under section 2 of the United
Nations (Security Council) Act, 1948 (XIV of 1948) read with the United Nations
Security Council (Freezing and Seizure) Order, 2019, published in the Gazette
of Pakistan on 4th March, 2019.

Punjab
Seized and Freezed Facilities (Hospitals and Dispensaries) Act, 2019 was passed

It

ancillary thereto.
Be
it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
3. Board.---(1) For the efficient management and control of
the Facilities, the Government shall, by notification in the official Gazette,
constitute a Board to be known as Hospitals and Dispensaries Management Board.
(2) The
Board shall be a body corporate, shall have perpetual succession and a common
seal, with power to enter into contracts and to acquire, hold and dispose of
property, movable and immovable, and shall in its name sue and be sued.
(3) The
Board shall consist of the following:
(a)
Secretary to the
Government, Primary and Secondary Healthcare Department;
Chairperson
(b)
Secretary to the
Government, Finance Department or his nominee not below the rank of an
Additional Secretary;
Vice Chairperson
(c)
Secretary to the
Government, Law and Parliamentary Affairs Department or his nominee not below
the rank of an Additional Secretary;
Member
(d)
Secretary to the
Government (Regulations Wing), Services and General Administration Department
or his nominee not below the rank of an Additional Secretary;
Member
(e)
Special Secretary to
the Government, Home Department or his nominee not below the rank of an
Additional Secretary;
Member
(f)
three non-official
members, including at least one woman, to be nominated by the Chief Minister
Punjab; and
Members
(g)
Director of the
Directorate.
Member/Secretary
(4) The non-official members shall have such
qualification and experience and shall serve for such period as may be
prescribed through regulations.

Seized and Freezed Facilities (Hospitals and Dispensaries) Act, 2019 was passed

Be
it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
6. Powers of the Board.---Subject to
the provisions of the Act, the Board shall have the powers to:
(a) acquire and dispose of a property and to
enter into contracts;
(b) recruit and determine terms and conditions of
employees of the Facilities, including special dispensation if required;
(c) formulate the budget of the Facilities;
(d) lay down the procedure for the conduct of its
business;
(e) set up any Committee as may be required for
carrying out the purposes of the Act;
(f) hire the services of employees belonging to
the other Provinces as one-time dispensation only; and
(g) delegate powers to the Chairperson, a
Committee set up under the Act or any employee of the Board, except power to
make rules or frame regulations.

Be
it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
8. Transitional provisions for employees of the
Facilities.---Any person, not below the age of eighteen years,
employed in connection with the affairs of the Facilities, in any capacity
immediately before the date notified under the Act, hereinafter referred to as
the "said date", shall be deemed to have been the employees of the
Board on such terms and conditions as the Board may determine:
Provided that such terms and conditions
shall not be less favorable than those admissible to an employee immediately
before coming into force of the Act:
Provided further that no such employee
shall be dismissed or removed from employment or reduced in rank by any
authority other than the Board.

(2) The Board Fund shall consist of:
(a) grants-in-aid made by the Government;
(b) loans obtained from the Government;
(c) aid and loans obtained by the Board with the

sections.description:
Validation

ACT XXII OF 2019
ACT XXII OF 2019
PUNJAB SEIZED AND FREEZED FACILITIES
(HOSPITALS AND DISPENSARIES) ACT, 2019
An Act to establish the Hospitals and Dispensaries
Management Board in the Punjab
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
13th December, 2019]
Punjab
Seized and Freezed Facilities (Hospitals and Dispensaries) Act, 2019 was passed
by the Punjab Assembly on 20 November 2019; assented to by the Governor of the
Punjab on 10 December 2019; and was published in the Punjab Gazette (Extraordinary),
dated 13 December 2019, pages 2531-35.
It
is necessary to establish the Hospitals and Dispensaries Management Board; to
manage the seized and freezed Facilities; to ensure mainstreaming of employees
of such Facilities; and to provide for the matters connected therewith and
ancillary thereto.
Be
it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
20. Validation.---All orders made, proceedings taken, acts
done, instructions issued, powers exercised, appointments made thereunder by any
authority which were made, taken, done or purported to have been made, taken,
done, issued, or exercised immediately before the commencement of the Act and
after the said date, shall be deemed to have been validly made, taken, done,
issued or exercised and deemed always to have had effect accordingly.

22. Repeal and Saving.---(1) The
Punjab Seized and Freezed Facilities (Hospitals and Dispensaries) Ordinance
2019 (VI of 2019) is hereby repealed.
(2) Notwithstanding the repeal of the Punjab
Seized and Freezed Facilities (Hospitals and Dispensaries) Ordinance 2019 (VI
